title: 某一路没有输出：会不会是插头插反？
titleEn: One channel has no output: could the connector be reversed?
prompt: 设备有一路完全没有输出，相邻一路正常。连接器带键位，但键位可能被强行插反。请选出更合理的检查顺序。按公开资料整理。
promptEn: One channel has no output at all; a neighbour works. The connector is keyed, but the key may have been forced the wrong way. Pick the more reasonable check order. Compiled from public information.

options.zh: 先看插头和插座的键位、丝印是否对上，再通电
options.en: Check that the key and silkscreen on the plug and socket line up, before applying power

options.zh: 先加大电源电流把那一路‘顶亮’
options.en: Raise the supply current to force that channel on

options.zh: 先把两路输出短接对比
options.en: Short the two outputs together to compare them

source.note: 题面自己写；连到已有维修关卡 led-dead-battery

title: 小夜灯完全不亮：先查电池还是先换灯珠？
titleEn: The night light is completely dark: battery first, or a new LED?
prompt: 一盏用电池的小夜灯完全不亮，开关感觉正常。更稳妥的第一步是什么？做完选择题可以进入对应的维修关卡。题面自己写。按公开资料整理。
promptEn: A battery night light is completely dark; the switch still feels normal. What is the safer first step? After the quiz you can open the matching repair level. Original wording. Compiled from public information.

options.zh: 先换一颗新灯珠再通电
options.en: Fit a new LED and apply power

options.zh: 先取出电池，用表量电池电压，并看极性和接触是否干净
options.en: Take the battery out, measure its voltage, and check polarity and clean contact

options.zh: 先把两节电池叠起来提高电压再试
options.en: Stack an extra cell to raise the voltage and try again

source.note: 题面自己写；只引用公开 NASA Lessons Learned 编号和失效模式名

title: 换了灯珠还是不亮：先查什么？
titleEn: The new LED still does not light: what do you check first?
prompt: 客户说刚换的 LED 还是不亮，电源极性可能被接反。下面哪一项是更稳妥的第一步？做完选择题可以进入对应的维修关卡。失效模式名称来自公开资料，题面是自己写的。按公开资料整理。
promptEn: A customer says a newly replaced LED still does not light, and the supply polarity may be reversed. Which first step is safer? After the quiz you can open the matching repair level. The failure-mode name comes from public sources; the wording is original. Compiled from public information.

questions.prompt: 上电之前更稳妥的一步是？
questions.promptEn: Before applying power, which step is safer?

options.zh: 先把电源直接加上，看灯会不会亮
options.en: Apply power immediately and see if the LED lights

options.zh: 先核对 LED 和电源的极性标记，再用表确认电压方向
options.en: Check polarity markings on the LED and supply, then confirm voltage direction with a meter

options.zh: 先换一颗更大电流的灯珠再试
options.en: Fit a higher-current LED and try again

title: 灯很暗，几乎看不见：电阻是不是装错了？
titleEn: The lamp is almost too dim to see: is the resistor wrong?
prompt: 灯能亮，但暗得几乎看不见。电源电压看起来正常。更合理的检查是什么？按公开资料整理。
promptEn: The lamp lights, but it is almost too dim to see. The supply voltage looks normal. What is the more reasonable check? Compiled from public information.

options.zh: 先读限流电阻的色环或字标，并量它的阻值，再和电路需要的估算值对照
options.en: Read the current-limiting resistor's colour bands or marking, measure it, and compare with the value the circuit needs (an estimate)

options.zh: 先把电阻拆掉，让灯珠直接接电源
options.en: Remove the resistor and wire the LED straight to the supply

options.zh: 先换成更大的电池把灯‘顶亮’
options.en: Fit a bigger battery to force the lamp brighter
